import { HistoryBudget, HISTORY_LIMITS } from './history-pagination';
// This transport is exclusive to explicit history actions. Accounting includes
// every raw response byte and each parent/chapter page, not only logical calls.
export async function historyJson(url: string, budget: HistoryBudget, native = false): Promise<{ status: number; body: unknown }> {
  budget.request();
  const response = await fetch(url, { method: 'GET', credentials: native ? 'omit' : 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', redirect: 'error', signal: budget.signal, headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
  budget.check();
  const reader = response.body?.getReader();
  if (!reader) throw Error('History lookup returned no response body');
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = []; let size = 0;
  try {
    if (!(response.headers.get('Content-Type') ?? '').includes('application/json')) throw Error('History lookup returned non-JSON data');
    for (;;) {
      budget.check(); const next = await reader.read(); budget.check();
      if (next.done) break;
      size += next.value.byteLength; budget.consume(next.value.byteLength);
      if (size > HISTORY_LIMITS.responseBytes) throw Error('History response exceeds its byte budget. This batch was not skipped.');
      chunks.push(next.value);
    }
  } catch (error) { void reader.cancel().catch(() => {}); throw error; }
  finally { reader.releaseLock(); }
  const data = new Uint8Array(size); let position = 0;
  for (const chunk of chunks) { data.set(chunk, position); position += chunk.byteLength; }
  budget.check();
  return { status: response.status, body: JSON.parse(new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(data)) };
}
